en: Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor limited, a state that is indeterminate and limited arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root: five; under predominance: five ... mutual: three ... resultant: three ... non-disappearance: five.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor exalted, a state that is indeterminate and exalted arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: three ... non-disappearance: three.

Conditioned by a state that is neither unwholesome nor immeasurable, a wholesome immeasurable state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are six; ... pe ... under repetition [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under result [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are six.
